title: Filipino-Style Pancit Canton
description: A classic Filipino noodle dish made with stir-fried vegetables and your choice of protein, served with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and stir-fry until the onion is translucent.
Add the carrots and snow peas and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken breast and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce and oyster sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the Pancit Canton and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with a side of steamed vegetables.
